title: "Publications"

    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
---

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

source("R/data.R")
source("R/viz.R")
d <- seec_read_data()

updated <- with_tz(Sys.time(), "Africa/Johannesburg")

pubs <- d$pubs %>%
  mutate(
    year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Year)),
    Journal = normalise_journal(Journal),
    n_authors = count_authors(`All authors`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))

pubs_yearly <- pubs %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    publications = n(),
    journals     = n_distinct(Journal, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_authors = median(n_authors[n_authors > 0]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

last_full_year <- current_year - 1
n_last <- sum(pubs$year == last_full_year)
n_prev <- sum(pubs$year == last_full_year - 1)
n_now  <- sum(pubs$year == current_year)
change <- if (n_prev > 0) round(100 * (n_last - n_prev) / n_prev) else NA
```

::: last-updated
Last updated `r format(updated, "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")`
:::

```{r}
stat_row(
  stat_tile(paste("Publications in", last_full_year), n_last,
            if (!is.na(change)) paste0(ifelse(change >= 0, "+", ""), change, "% vs ", last_full_year - 1)),
  stat_tile(paste(current_year, "so far"), n_now),
  stat_tile("Publications to date", fmt_num(nrow(pubs)),
            paste0(min(pubs$year), "–", max(pubs$year))),
  stat_tile("Journals", n_distinct(pubs$Journal, na.rm = TRUE),
            "distinct journals published in"),
  stat_tile("Median authors per paper", median(pubs$n_authors[pubs$n_authors > 0]),
            "a measure of collaboration")
)
```

## Output over time

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_columns(
  pubs_yearly, "year", "publications",
  title = "SEEC-affiliated publications per year",
  subtitle = paste0(current_year, " (lighter bar) is still in progress"),
  partial = current_year,
  unit = " publications"
)
```
:::

```{r}
numbers_view(seec_numbers(
  pubs_yearly %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    transmute(Year = year, Publications = publications,
              `Distinct journals` = journals, `Median authors` = median_authors),
  columns = list(Year = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = FALSE)))
))
```

## Where SEEC publishes

```{r}
top_journals <- pubs %>%
  filter(!is.na(Journal)) %>%
  count(Journal, name = "papers", sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12)
```

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_hbars(
  top_journals, "Journal", "papers",
  title = "Most frequent journals",
  subtitle = paste0("Top 12 · ", min(pubs$year), "–", max(pubs$year)),
  label_fmt = function(v) paste(v, "papers")
)
```
:::

## All publications

```{r}
pubs_table <- pubs %>%
  arrange(desc(year), Title) %>%
  mutate(doi_id = sub("^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", DOI)) %>%
  select(Year = year, Title, Journal, `SEEC author(s)`, DOI = doi_id)

seec_table(
  pubs_table,
  id = "publications",
  columns = list(
    Year = colDef(maxWidth = 80),
    Title = colDef(minWidth = 320),
    Journal = colDef(minWidth = 180),
    `SEEC author(s)` = colDef(minWidth = 180),
    DOI = colDef(
      minWidth = 120,
      cell = function(v) {
        if (is.na(v) || v == "") return("")
        htmltools::tags$a(href = paste0("https://doi.org/", v), target = "_blank", "Open")
      }
    )
  ),
  page_size = 25
)
```
